records.StoryText:
Taffy’s early days as an Agent were pure fulfillment.
Her work was a breeze, and the Rifts she checked out seemed harmless.
Despite the occasional annoying tasks, she always found time to slack off and take it easy.
Little did she know, a major ACD figure had their eyes fixed on her every move.

The ACD big shots saw potential in Taffy, believing she could become a legend with a bit more experience.
They slipped a weapon loan contract in with her weekly reports.
Ignoring the fine print, Taffy signed off, unknowingly landing herself 20 million in debt.
Now, she’s stuck paying around 100,000 a month for the next thirty years.
If Taffy bails on her payments, she’ll get labeled as a deadbeat. She’ll lose her current lifestyle perks and all the cool things in her life that bring her joy…
Unable to cover the debt with her Agent’s salary, she had to also sign up as a courier for Lightleap Express.

Taffy’s a total manga weeb with killer taste and sharp insights.
She’s a hardcore ‘Shonen Fly’ fan.
Anywhere in Nova, you can catch Taffy lounging on her bike, casually flipping through manga. Even pro editors hit her up for advice on new releases.

A cutting-edge marvel embodying ACD’s pinnacle tech, presently undergoing field trials and hasn’t been pushed to its limits yet.
Its sky-high price tag plays a starring role in Taffy’s daunting 20 million debt.

The fizzy buzz of the soda bursting in her mouth sends Taffy into an invigorating frenzy.
For her, skipping a day of sleep or food is no big deal, but going without cola? She might as well be half-dead.

Most people in Nova City see Lykaia as a lone wolf, the bringer of dawn, the city’s leader—imposing, majestic, and just.
Most people in Nova are her supporters.
Only some of the younger crowd, swayed by rumors, think Lykaia is in cahoots with the Reign Group.
She was indeed once the heiress of Nova’s biggest conglomerate, the Reign Group, but she ditched that identity over a decade ago.
Whenever anyone asks her why, she just dodges the question, saying she’s too swamped with work.

Lykaia has this knack for figuring out exactly what her target needs, using it as leverage—her ‘wolf instincts’ in action.
But Lykaia, who always puts the big picture first, rarely thinks about herself. It seems like she’s always, consciously or not, keeping her own desires in check.

Driving around the city is one of Lykaia’s few hobbies and her only way to let off steam.
She likes the feeling of being behind the wheel, as it gives her the sense that something is moving towards a goal under her command.
Apart from tearing through Paradox Plaza, she often drives to Nova’s ocean bridge in the early mornings.
Just leaning against the car, sipping on coffee, jamming to the radio, and watching the sunrise through the mist.
After the first whistle of a ship on a distant voyage, she drives to her office and starts her day.

ACD data from Anonym shows Lykaia became compatible with Psionic Power Weapons early.
Her Cryo Psionic Power, ‘Breaking Dawn,’ allows her to solidify her deepest attachments into ice formations,
yet her inner ferocity renders it unpredictable and perilous to wield.
The ACD produced a custom flag spear as a crucial channel for her Psionic Power.
Like other Channelers with canine traits, the body temps of these Channelers are 1-2°C higher than normal humans.

Lykaia’s temperature rises abruptly when she uses her Psionic Power as the surrounding temperature plummets.
*Lykaia’s file contains another report, but much of the material has been deleted.
It has to do with a wolf-eared Channeler who used their Psionic Power to create an entire city to trap a massive Maniac Chao. The wolf-eared Channeler was in a state of shock for 2 months afterward.

A pair of small plushies hang off the rearview mirror of the car Lykaia normally drives.
One plushie looks like her and is ornate.
The other looks a bit clumsily made.
When asked about the plushies, Lykaia’s face takes on a rare expression. She looks away and lightly twirls her wolf ears: “I’m not very crafty, but I didn’t realize how skilled she was…”

-雷恩集团长大的孩子在十多岁时,都会被要求领养一只宠物…
-正巧,我在森林里遇到了卢卡,一只蓝色眼眸的流浪犬。
-但没人告诉我那是一只幼狼。’
-在我们相处的半年里,卢卡从来都没攻击过我,直到成人礼那天…
-我被告知要亲手杀了它。
-大人的笑声,随时准备看一场好戏,在他们眼里,只有强者才能活下去。
-而我只能持着匕首颤抖......
-但我还没反应过来,卢卡就朝着匕首扑了上来,那种感觉就像是在寻死。
-然后,我逃走了。
-一直跑,直到眼泪流干,喉咙嘶哑,双腿无力,直到精疲力竭时…
-我才发现,我长出了一对狼耳朵。

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                熟悉的新启海岸,风扬起了她的头发。
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                她望着远处启程的货轮,突然笑了。
-陪我再喝一杯吧。

records.StoryText: An enigmatic figure with silver locks, always showing up at crucial moments.

Dila’s words are straightforward and unembellished.
She doesn’t play with language; she lets it be what it is, raw and real.

Capturing all she witnesses, Dila shares Chaos tales anonymously on Nova City’s forum to ease her solitude.
The stories she shared ended up going viral,
turning her pen name “BBB” into a hot topic among urban legend enthusiasts. Netizens debated the authenticity of the Chaos stories and spun wild theories about “BBB.” Some say she’s a special Agent, while others imagine her as a powerful Chao that relishes challenging others before chronicling those encounters to boast. “BBB” herself became part of the urban legend.

Forged from Dila’s will, this greatsword exists in the space between reality and illusion. It materializes and vanishes at her command, like a celestial specter, heralding silent devastation wherever she directs it.

In her free time, Dila roams the vibrant streets of Nova City, seeking inspiration. She wanders aimlessly, taking random turns and diving into hidden alleys. For her, this isn’t just a stroll; it’s an adventure.
Along the way, she might encounter floating jellyfish, cross paths with the Masked Malice, or be drawn to hidden Chaos lurking in the shadows. Dila often gets lost, but that’s the beauty of wandering—every step brings fresh surprises and a hint of danger.

From family drama on Portview Lane to high-stakes investment showdowns in the Azure Sector, you can bet Alan’s got the scoop.
As the go-to information broker, he’s got the inside track on everything, and if you’ve got the cash, you can tap into it.
“Leave the intel snooping to me, I’ve got you covered.”

On top of his bustling informant business, Alan’s carved out his own space in the digital world.
He regularly drops videos showcasing his epic yo-yo tricks and streams his outdoor adventures.
Sure, he’s an “influencer”—he might not have the biggest following, but definitely on the radar. His online persona has become a powerful asset for his intel operations.

With a bright smile and an easygoing vibe, Alan’s the kind of guy who lights up a room.
He’s the friend everyone turns to in a pinch, tackling challenges with a can-do attitude.
But don’t let his carefree demeanor fool you; underneath that jovial exterior is a sharp, strategic mind.

Alan possesses a unique ability to manipulate an object’s rotation, guiding it along a spiral path that seems to go on forever.
The catch? His mastery depends on how well he understands the object and its context.
As he gathers intel, the spirals he creates begin to mirror the Fibonacci sequence—perfectly intertwined with the geometry of knowledge.
After Alan hit 100,000 subscribers, a loyal fan sent him a quirky rubber ducky as a celebration gift. Now it sits proudly on his desk, a symbol of his achievements and the community he’s built.

At first glance, Ringo looks like an average bubbly high school girl.
Little do folks know, she’s actually a member of the D.P.A. Catch her at Dream Garden Cafe and she might not be scrolling through vids, but handling logistics for the ACD.

She’s a total open book, wearing her emotions like a badge.
When someone throws shade her way online, she’s quick with the clap back. But hey, she’s not about dumping her feelings on others. She’s all about empathy, stepping into her friends’ shoes.

Fluffington Cafe for cat cuddles or Dream Garden for some killer pudding?
Or should I go to 1UP to play rhythm games? Maybe later, there’s always someone hogging the machines.
Oh, that band I used to follow has a gig at Sonic Boom tonight.
Maybe I should check my horoscope.
Having too many choices are stressing Ringo out.

Ringo’s got Psionic Power on lock, materializing her emotions into explosive emote balls. She channels her feelings into these balls that straight-up explode based on her vibes.
She can even pass them to others to ease their moods. At first, she tried using a toy gun as her ‘launcher,’
but that plan went up in smoke real quick—literally singed her brows once. After some ACD upgrades, her weapon’s way more on-point. Now, while she’s repping as a liaison, she’s also keeping minor Chaos in check.

When she joined the D.P.A, people were skeptical, calling her “unreliable” ’cause she was fresh and had an emote as her profile pic. Anonym suggested she switch it to something more ’serious-looking’, and bam!
Her communication efficiency shot through the roof. After meeting <player> and Taffy, she ditched the serious vibe and went back to her old avatar. It was such a relief not having to be all work, no play.

Nova City’s detective scene just got a jolt of new energy, courtesy of the rising star, Christina.
The NCCA tapped her for three ancient cold cases:
the Nova City Clipper, Maslow Manor, and a wild hotel jewelry heist.
These were head-scratchers,but Christina, the fresh blood, easily cracked them while the old-timers were still puzzling.
Everyone expected much from her, but she flipped the script, dipped from the NCCA,
and set up her own gumshoe joint in the Azure Sector. No more big-time crook hunts—now she’s all about community service.
“Finding lost cats and sniffing out cheaters… that’s interesting too right?”
“There’s more to life than just the big fish.”
“Truth holds its own weight, doesn’t it?”

Christina’s origin is shrouded in mystery.
Christina’s past is a deep, dark secret. No one knows where she came from.
The Prime Minister’s Office has a file with her name on it, but a perceptive person would know that other than her gender, the rest of the info, even her name, isn’t reliable. She appeared in Nova City out of thin air, like an enigma.
“Both a truth-seeking detective and lady of mystery.”

When she’s not chasing leads, Christina’s all about mall-hopping.
Money’s the last thing on her mind.
If something catches her eye, consider it scooped. No questions asked. But here’s the twist—she doesn’t keep any of it. Nope, it’s all wrapped up and gifted under the cover of night, spreading joy like a fairy godmother.
“I’ve been given the keys to make their dreams happen.”

Word on the street says Christina’s Psionic Powers are tied to a ‘key’.
She pulls data from the world to craft a Golden Key, a sort of truth-unlocking, interconnecting tool.
It’s also a mean weapon for slicing and dicing foes.
“Isn’t anything but the raw truth just a lie?”

A treasured novel in Christina’s collection, hidden from prying eyes.
“Her deeds once rocked the world, now lost to history’s whispers.”
Notorious graffiti artist of Nova City with a penchant for pop culture. She can often be seen slinging paint around Paradox Plaza.

Bansy is an energetic empath with a love for life.
If only others could get on her level… With such a creative and free spirit, her only plan is no plans. What will she create? When? Where? How? Only she knows.

For Bansy, graffiti is a lifestyle. Spray paint runs through her veins.
There isn’t a single corner in all of Paradox Plaza without her tag. Her Psionic Power triggers a ‘creative frenzy’. When inspiration strikes, so do her spray cans on the nearest ’canvas’. Only then can she clear her mind.
“I’m SO sorry! I won’t do it again. I swear!”—Bansy pleading desperately to an infuriated officer.

As the “Graffiti Hero” emerged with a bold, fresh style, it deeply influenced Bansy in her formative years. As she rose in the scene, a graffiti shop bestowed this weapon upon her.
Rumor has it, it once belonged to the “Graffiti Hero”. Though resembling a toy, it resonates with Bansy’s Psionic Power, firing graffiti rounds to disorient foes.

Her distinctive graffiti style has garnered a devoted fanbase. Open to both accolades and critiques,
she occasionally takes on storefront projects. Yet, she staunchly refuses commercial commissions or selling her art as a ‘product’ at any expense.
“Graffiti is the art of the people!” she insists.

Whispers speak of a ghost artisan haunting the late nights at Marine MechWorks. When the sun dips and the crew clocks out, this figure takes the reins, ensuring the machinery meet production targets.
After resolving the meteorite incident at Marine MechWorks, this enigmatic ghost artisan’s true identity was unveiled—Mechanika.

Never straying far from Marine MechWorks, she retains an innocent wonder about the world.
Mechanika is quite the dab-hand with mecha, crafting an exotic suite of mods—even if they aren’t exactly “practical”.

As darkness descends, Marine MechWorks transforms into a playground for Mechanika and her partners in mischief, the Radionauts. While commanding Radionauts to possess machines throughout the workshop, Mechanika also likes to host her own “concerts”.
Some claim the echoes are machines coming to life, others hear mysterious radio signals resonating with the factory, while a few swear they’ve heard the ghostly cackle of a vengeful girl wandering the factory floor.

Mechanika’s sidekicks. With aid from the Radionauts, Mechanika showcases her Psionic Power through electrifying tingles, electric orbs, and virtual concerts.
Radionauts are impressive on their own, but they truly shine when merged with Mechanika’s prowess.
The mischievous Radionauts can even “inhabit” electronic devices, hijacking radio shows, flickering streetlights, and getting lost in complex circuitry. When it comes to these troublemakers, all anyone can do is shrug in resignation.

Originally developed by Marine MechWorks, Coeus was discontinued due to cumbersome controls.
However, with Mechanika’s modifications and a little help from the Radionauts, Coeus now displays impressive capabilities and provides significant firepower to MM.
When Chaos attempt to invade MM, Coeus will appear and repel them. Of course, the mischievous Radionauts have considered using Coeus to scare others, but Mechanika won’t allow it.

Luminary Academy’s captain of the archery club and “prodigal archer”.
Appears noble and aloof, preferring to go solo.

Whenever fully locked in, she’s prone to edgy comments, which only further embarrass her after the fact.
“This is the archery technique destined to annihilate countless realms, a single shot that channels the essence of our martial spirit!”

Undoubtedly a standout figure at the academy.
Rin’s striking looks and archery triumphs have garnered her considerable praise from academy officials.
That being said, Lin isn’t without her dissenters.
Some claim that she’s merely a pretty face, and all her victories were rigged.

Rin excels at forging and modifying weapons.
She’s all about blending old-school smithing techniques with modern methods for her gear.
The mask gifted to Rin by her grandfather allows her to more easily enter a state of complete focus when she wears it.

Garm, the fearsome Champion Warrior, strikes awe and dread into all who tread Paradox Plaza.
Whenever she steps into the arena, fans battle for coveted seats,
drawn by her intense fervor and unyielding combat prowess that has propelled Garm to the zenith of championship glory.

Garm is the leader of DK9, a major force in Paradox Plaza.
Garm leads her pack in both relentless training sessions and maintaining peace within the district.
When not in the spotlight, she’s pounding the gym to keep her physique at its peak.

Unapologetically outspoken, Garm fearlessly champions her beliefs
and stands unwaveringly by those she deems allies, offering steadfast support.
“DK9 never turns away a friend—ask for anything you need!”

Garm’s bond with the Demon Hound elevates her combat prowess,
while the Hound gains strength from their symbiotic relationship.
Together, they unleash fiery attacks against adversaries, and scorch them in flames.
Yet the Hound’s aura marks Garm as public enemy number one among feline foes.

Gifted by the OG leader of the DK9 crew after Garm aced the trials and leveled up to a true warrior.
This bad boy not only packs a punch but laughs in the face of scorching heat.

The indomitable NCCA District Captain, with colossal strength and an even more colossal appetite. Revered as the “Monster Hero,” Richie is the pinnacle of strength within the NCCA. She stands shoulder to shoulder with her allies, defending Nova City’s forefront.

Richie has a monstrous appetite and a bottomless pit for a stomach. She set a record in a Nova City food-eating championship for devouring 50 hotdogs in 10 minutes.
Her hunger isn’t limited to food; she consumes enemies, vehicles, and even structures to boost her strength.
Whenever she’s running low on energy in battle, a quick bite will do the trick. With strength several times that of a human, her resting grip strength hits 500 kg. She has to focus not to cause serious harm. The upper limits of her strength post-meal remain a mystery.

At just 9 years old, Richie’s world shattered when the orphanage she called home was engulfed in a wave of Chaos.
Trapped in the ruins, her survival instincts kicked in, and she devoured everything in sight —supplies, expired food, garbage, even concrete.
Her relentless hunger led her to consume her beloved childhood companion—a slime plushie. However, Chaos within the plushie unwittingly activated her Psionic Power, transforming her into the Monster Maiden.

Initially, Richie struggled under the weight of her newfound powers and the hunger that came with them. 
She feared the label of becoming a “killing machine with an insatiable appetite” that others threw her way.

She despises her ears and tail for setting her apart from ordinary people.
Despite her love for food, she has begun refusing to eat, growing thin, and increasingly reclusive. But her life took a turn when Lykaia found her amidst the ruins. Lykaia, who bears wolf ears and a tail, reassured her, saying,
“There’s nothing wrong with being different.
Monsters wield their power for evil, while heroes wield their power for good.
Learn to channel your strength for the right reasons.

You don’t have to be a monster; you can be a hero for the people Richie decided to accept herself, learning to control her power and define herself. Joining Lykaia, she trained, resisted Chaos, and embraced responsibility. In Nova City, she became a District Captain, earning a reputation as the ”Monster Hero,“ relishing the change from her previous label as a ”killing machine with an insatiable appetite.“

When Lykaia pulled Richie from the Chaos-laden ruins, it wasn’t just about saving her life—it was about seeing whether she would Eclipse and turn into something truly monstrous.
Once Richie’s condition had stabilized, they were hit with a harsh reality: her memories were a jumbled mess.
She had completely blocked out her time trapped in the shadows, along with the refuse and debris she had consumed to survive.
Instead, she was adamant that it was all because she had saved a girl in red. Tests revealed that Richie’s memories had been jumbled due to the intense trauma she had experienced.
Upon awakening her Psionic Power, she seemed to forget about the event entirely. While those around her described her as normally calm and collected, when she awakened, it was as if all her memories had been wiped clean. As for the girl in red she saved? She is actually a projection of herself; a coping mechanism to shield from the pain. Those around her refrain from speaking of it.

Amidst the bustling city life and a myriad of shops and boutiques,
Glimmergold Lane stands out as the heartbeat of Nova City. This trendy shopping area is a vibrant hub where the city’s pulse is felt strongest.
Among the myriad of shops, Dream Garden Cafe leaves an indelible mark.
After over a decade of operation, this beloved spot has managed to stay fresh and relevant, charming visitors and locals alike.
From maid-costumed waitresses to delightful tea, scrumptious desserts, and engaging staff interactions, Dream Garden Cafe has etched its legendary status on Glimmergold.
Currently at the helm is the “Perfect Maid,” Aileen.
“Welcome home~ I’m Aileen, your hostess at Dream Garden Cafe, here to serve you.

Aileen’s piercing gaze is the first thing most people notice.
Once the crown jewel of the now-defunct reality company Reign Group, she received an elite education and upbringing.
Despite her privileged background, there’s something truly captivating about her.
Now, having shed her past to work as a maid at Dream Garden Cafe, revealing her softer side remains a challenge.
Regardless, some customers take joy in her disdain and torment, leading to misunderstandings about the real Aileen.
“As long as I’m helping people, who cares if they get me wrong?”

Beyond managing the cafe, Aileen doubles as the unofficial guardian of Glimmergold Lane.
From rowdy troublemakers and rude customers to unethical businesses and lost kids looking for their families,
if there’s a problem on Glimmergold, Aileen is always ready to swoop in and save the day.

Aileen is a massive fan of Chongxiao kung fu flicks.
Old video stores are her treasure troves, where she rents classic films, learning and mimicking the moves until she developed her own unique fighting style.
Unbeknownst to her, she’s now far surpassed the average fighter; to her, it’s always just been a fun hobby.

Years ago, Aileen represented Reign Group in a shady attempt to acquire Dream Garden Cafe.
But now, she sees it as her sanctuary—a refuge for those seeking a fresh start and a place where dreams can bloom anew.

Neon Saber Senior, Unrivaled Sorcerer, Ultimate Parry-Striker… This popular streamer is known by numerous titles in the gaming community. She also occasionally livestreams Chaos incidents. She kicked off her journey as a vtuber, but later abruptly dropped the mask, revealing her true identity.

“Mimiko is Life!” is often spammed in the chat whenever she starts a stream. On stream, she’s a whirlwind of energy, bringing an infectious vibe that keeps her audience hooked. Never one to shy away from a challenge, she usually crushes her opponents effortlessly. Her streams are a blend of good vibes and intense chat interaction, but there’s a mystery lingering in the air. Fans have started to share wild stories of IRL encounters—someone who looks just like her, but when they go to say hi, the shy introvert doesn’t match the fiery Mimiko they know and love.

By day, she’s Misora Mio, a whiz kid in the Computer Science Department at Luminary Academy. Crushing her coursework in a quarter of the usual time, she races home to power up her rig and grab her controller. Her go-to game is Neon Saber.
Lately, she’s been grinding out more advanced moves, though she admits to getting a bit winded after a few rounds—probably missing that good old sunshine. Her new mission? Step outside at least once a week. When she’s not gaming, she’s diving deep into her other passion—Chaos. Devouring urban legends and articles online. Her irregular stream schedule adds to her mystique, but the “Mimiko Chaos Expedition Special” is definitely on the radar! (After she’s charged up her “go-out” energy.)

The Electro-Octo, custom-made for Mimiko by a friend at Blueprint Soft, offers high modular flexibility. With pinpoint precision and unmatched tactile feedback, the Electro-Octo is Mimiko’s secret weapon in the gaming universe—and a fierce ally against aggressive Chaos. Plus, with her unique Psionic Power, she can manifest “Neon Saber,” to attack foes in real life and when paired with the Sea Hare VR set, she’s always ready for the next adventure with Chaos.

She’s the type who lights up at the sight of rare figurines and custom gear. When a new game drops, you can bet her smile stretches from ear to ear. But don’t let her sunny disposition fool you; with her depth of experience, not even the most insufficient shovelware escapes her razor-sharp critiques on stream.
Despite his young age, the director of Aerie Bank holds the economic lifeline of Nova City in his hands.

Talking to him feels like chatting across a chasm; there’s a cool distance wrapped up in his demeanor. Yet, his politeness and smooth mannerisms create an undercurrent of goodwill.
The moment someone tries to close that gap, though, you can feel the boundaries he strategically maintains. Bernard is a master negotiator, wielding a sharp authority when it comes to the bank’s interests, dropping truth bombs with absolute bluntness. When it’s time for personal matters, he plays it cool, shrugging off slander and dodging arguments, a tactic that often backfires on those who challenge him.

Bernard’s psionic power takes shape as a clone that embodies the essence of time, complete with clock-like elements and a built-in countdown feature.
After that timer hits zero, Bernard experiences nightmares that night, where he experiences death in the most visceral and agonizing ways.

But in moments of crisis, he can summon this clone to help lighten the load.
Though it’s usually cold and expressionless, the clone operates with laser-like focus and precision, tackling tasks seamlessly without uttering a single word.

The distant branch of the Leones family had a twisted way of standing out. They would send their children around Bernard’s age to keep him company, but it wasn’t just for fun. These children had a mission: to protect the young master, even if it meant laying down their lives.
During an unprecedented kidnapping of Bernard, his kin, Buck, unfortunately got caught up in the incident as well. Terrified and bitter, Buck attempted to abandon Bernard but fell right into a trap, ultimately meeting a brutal end at the hands of their captors.
After Bernard narrowly escaped, he didn’t spill the details of Buck’s tragic fate. In the cold, calculating world of the Leones family, no one mourned the loss.
Instead, they regarded it as a fitting end to a failed sacrifice. Witnessing Buck’s dying curses and his family’s chilling indifference left Bernard’s heart heavy with doubt.

Following that harrowing night, Bernard was unable to shake the feeling that he was living a coward’s existence.
Buck’s death hung over him like a dark cloud, filling him with shame. He was determined not to build his own strength on the back of someone else’s sacrifice. Self-destructive tendencies crept in, and he thought it was better to die honorably than to live with a name tarnished by indifference.
However, soon after, a vague shadow began to linger around him. Initially, Bernard attributed it to Buck’s vengeful spirit, haunting him for the events that transpired. Yet, as time passed, that indistinct silhouette began to morph into something eerily familiar—a figure that bore an uncanny resemblance to himself.
This was Bernard’s first clone, a haunting reminder of the “what if” scenario. What if it had been him who died? And one night, that chilling possibility came to life in a vivid dream, forcing him to confront the darkness that followed him.

For a long time, Bernard viewed his clone as a twisted kind of self-punishment, forcing him to relive the fear of death over and over in his dreams.
It was only after hitting rock bottom that he realized this was no curse—it was a gift he had been taking for granted.
Maybe this power wasn’t about punishment at all. This epiphany ignited a spark of courage within him, propelling him to forge ahead.

Seymour doesn’t see himself as having escaped the research facility; instead, he views that tumultuous episode as a “system reboot.” An opportunity to create a new world.
At first, he tried to live like an ordinary person, but he couldn’t understand why people wasted time chatting while waiting in line for coffee.
He attempted to rent an apartment, but the landlord deemed him a “suspicious character” for refusing to take off his mask as well as for his overly exacting negotiation tactics.
Eventually, he decided to live in a converted RV, which he has subsequently arranged to his liking.
Perhaps one day he’ll accomplish the lofty goals he held when he left the research facility—but not just yet.

Seymour is not devoid of emotions; he merely processes them as a set of parameters which require optimization.
In the research facility, he learned computer languages well before human language. All his behaviors were embedded into prediction models and decision tree analyses.
His processor has reserved excessive space for philosophy and wisdom, while the space allocated for the more complex human emotions is rather limited. This makes it difficult for him to navigate this chaos concrete jungle which is driven by emotions.
He has learned is to mimic the social niceties which are necessary for interpersonal interactions, merely nodding his head slightly behind his mask.

Seymour’s RV is extremely minimalist in its arrangement. Each item has both a designated place and a clear purpose: a modified signal amplifier, a custom decryption module, and several computing interface prototypes.
The only exception is the cat’s bed, which draws the most attention upon entering the RV. Seymour makes a rare exception for the cat in that he tolerates it disrupting the arrangement of his homestead.

Seymour’s hands are the reassuring threads which carve their way through the digital maze. The keyboard under his fingertips is more than plastic and metal; it’s a bridge to an intangible realm, a clever tool for breaking through firewalls.
